title: Bank of Japan announces Comprehensive Monetary Easing
detail: Released as "Comprehensive Monetary Easing". The policy rate is recorded at 0 to 0.1 percent from this date.

title: Bank of Japan sets a price stability target
detail: Released as "The 'Price Stability Target' under the Framework for the Conduct of Monetary Policy".

title: Bank of Japan introduces Quantitative and Qualitative Monetary Easing
detail: Released as "Introduction of the 'Quantitative and Qualitative Monetary Easing'". The start of the Bank's large-scale government bond purchases.

title: Bank of Japan expands its easing
detail: Released as "Expansion of the Quantitative and Qualitative Monetary Easing".

title: Bank of Japan introduces a negative interest rate
detail: Released as "Introduction of 'Quantitative and Qualitative Monetary Easing with a Negative Interest Rate'".

title: Bank of Japan enhances its easing
Bank of Japan adopts yield curve control
detail: Released as "New Framework for Strengthening Monetary Easing: 'Quantitative and Qualitative Monetary Easing with Yield Curve Control'".

title: Bank of Japan changes its policy framework and ends the negative rate
detail: Released as "Changes in the Monetary Policy Framework". The policy rate is recorded at 0 to 0.1 percent from 21 March 2024, up from minus 0.1 percent.

title: Bank of Japan raises its rate and plans smaller bond purchases
detail: Released as "Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations and Decision on the Plan for the Reduction of the Purchase Amount of Japanese Government Bonds". The policy rate is recorded at around 0.25 percent from 1 August 2024.

title: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 0.5 percent
detail: Released as "Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations". The policy rate is recorded at around 0.5 percent from 27 January 2025.

title: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 0.75 percent
detail: Released as "Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations". The policy rate is recorded at around 0.75 percent from 22 December 2025.

title: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 1 percent
detail: Released as "Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations", with a "Plan for the Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds". The policy rate is recorded at around 1 percent from 17 June 2026.

title: Bank of Japan raises its policy rate to 1.25 percent
detail: Released as "Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations". The policy rate is recorded at around 1.25 percent from 24 September 2026.
